verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a public REST API (Uptime API v2). The docs cover global and team-scoped API tokens, Bearer-header auth, CRUD endpoints for monitors (POST/PATCH/DELETE), and per-endpoint reference pages with copyable curl examples, filters and paginated JSON responses. The docs hub also points to automation via APIs and Terraform. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), no evidence of API coverage beyond Uptime resources (e.g. logs/telemetry), no independent or hands-on corroboration.
